versions.changelog:
Auto Report Generator Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automatically analyzes CSV/Excel files and generates professional reports with charts and written analysis.
- Supports one-click creation of weekly/monthly reports via the command line.
- Multiple report templates available (monthly, finance, sales, comparison, custom).
- Integrates with AI providers (OpenAI/DeepSeek) for analysis.
- Includes quota management with different subscription tiers (FREE/STD/PRO/MAX).
- Output supports multi-sheet Excel, with higher tiers offering PDF export and custom templates.
